GUNGANO Live

Showcase enquiries

Label talent showcases

The live showcase format of GUNGANO Records: a space to hear the label’s artists, discover their sound and connect with the talent behind the releases.

  • Label artists and emerging talent.
  • Curated performances and collaborative line-ups.
  • Showcase and venue-partnership enquiries.

A showcase can bring together artist performances, a curated musical progression and a venue brief built around the label’s identity. For promoters and collaborators, we discuss the format, location and production requirements before developing a programme.

One idea. Different places.

Our roaming project connects music, local talent and new audiences across Africa. We are exploring Nigeria, Kenya, Zimbabwe and South Africa, shaping each edition with local collaborators, venues and communities.

Locations are in development. Confirmed dates, venues and access details will be announced for each edition.
